historical_note: This document captures the first 27 runs of the Pulse Engine (2026-03-24 to 2026-03-26). By Run 229 (2026-04-01), the engine has executed 200+ additional runs, completing 6 full waves of Heavy Ledger conversion (72/72), progressing through Wave 7 (10/12), delivering 28 CANON/MARKETING files, Chrome Extension v0.3.0, and a complete 4-stage Facebook sales funnel pipeline. The system has evolved far beyond this snapshot but the foundational operational patterns documented here remain the bedrock.
